main.description: Grants a specific user global permission to use emotes from one of the author's packs.

did.description: The DID of the user being granted access to use these emotes.

pack.description: The pack the emotes come from. Must be owned by the record author.

emotes.description: Specific emotes from the pack to delegate. If absent, all emotes in the pack are delegated.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this delegation was created.
